description: Scans whose timestamp equals either boundary value are counted.

a.request: Take the scans whose timestamp (`chronotag`, compared as text) is from '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' through '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797', with both endpoints included, and keep only scans that match a site by site code. Group them by scan zone reference (`zoneref`) and site type (`typesite`). For each group, work out the average compression ratio (`pressratio`) and the average of file size divided by scan duration (`gbsize` / `spanmin`), ignoring missing values. Then give me one row with two unrounded values: the average of those per-group compression-ratio averages and the average of the per-group size-per-minute averages.
a.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT s.zoneref, si.typesite, s.pressratio, s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0) AS size_per_min FROM scans s JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE s.chronotag::text BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'), grouped AS (SELECT zoneref, typesite, AVG(pressratio) AS avg_press, AVG(size_per_min) AS avg_size_per_min FROM filtered GROUP BY zoneref, typesite) SELECT AVG(avg_press) AS avg_compression_ratio, AVG(avg_size_per_min) AS avg_size_per_minute FROM grouped;

c.request: For scans taken between '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' and '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' (comparing the `chronotag` text), and only those linked to a site by site code, group by zone reference (`zoneref`) and site type (`typesite`). For each group, get the average compression ratio (`pressratio`) and the average of file size divided by scan duration (`gbsize` / `spanmin`), ignoring missing values. Then give me one row with two unrounded values: the average of the per-group compression-ratio averages and the average of the per-group size-per-minute averages. Scans whose timestamp equals either boundary value are counted.
c.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT s.zoneref, si.typesite, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_min FROM scans s INNER JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE s.chronotag BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.typesite) SELECT AVG(avg_pressratio) AS avg_compression_ratio, AVG(avg_gb_per_min) AS avg_size_per_minute FROM grouped;

d.request: For scans whose `chronotag` text is between '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' and '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' inclusive (both boundaries included), joined to `sites` on `zoneref` = `zoneregistry`, grouped by `zoneref` and `typesite`, return one row with AVG(per-group AVG(`pressratio`)) and AVG(per-group AVG(`gbsize` / `spanmin`)), ignoring NULLs, with no rounding.
d.sql: SELECT AVG(g.avg_pressratio) AS avg_of_avg_pressratio, AVG(g.avg_gb_per_min) AS avg_of_avg_gbsize_per_spanmin FROM (SELECT s.zoneref, si.typesite, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio, AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) AS avg_gb_per_min FROM scans s JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE s.chronotag BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.typesite) g;

b.request: Scans with `chronotag` text from '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' through '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' inclusive, joined to `sites` on `zoneref = zoneregistry`, grouped by `zoneref` and `typesite`, averaging `pressratio` and `gbsize / spanmin` per group while ignoring nulls, then returning the unrounded averages of those per-group values as one row.
b.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT sc.zoneref, si.typesite, AVG(sc.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_min FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE sc.chronotag BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY sc.zoneref, si.typesite) SELECT AVG(avg_pressratio) AS avg_pressratio, AVG(avg_gb_per_min) AS avg_gb_per_min FROM grouped;
